arm.name: Arm
arm.description: Arm an Alarmo entity with custom settings.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarm entity that should be armed.

code.name: Code
code.description: Code to use for the arming.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Mode to arm the alarm in.

force.name: Force
force.description: Automatically bypass all sensors that prevent the arming operation.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarm entity that should be disarmed.

code.name: Code
code.description: Code to use for the disarming.

skip_delay.name: Skip Delay
skip_delay.description: Skip the remainder of the exit delay and arm now. Only has effect while the alarm is arming; during the entry delay (pending) it is refused, use alarm_control_panel.alarm_trigger to trigger the alarm at once.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Alarm entity for which the delay should be skipped.

enable_user.name: Enable User
enable_user.description: Allow a user to arm/disarm alarmo.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the user to enable.

disable_user.name: Disable User
disable_user.description: Block a user from arming/disarming alarmo.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the user to disable.

unbypass.name: Unbypass
unbypass.description: Watch bypassed sensors again while the alarm stays armed. Only sensors that are closed now are watched again; open ones stay bypassed. Returns the sensors that were rejoined and the ones still bypassed.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Armed alarm entity whose bypassed sensors should be watched again.

sensors.name: Sensors
sensors.description: Only these bypassed sensors (default: all bypassed sensors).
